blocks.goal: Extract the arithmetic and mutation responsibility (value field and all mutating/arithmetic operations) from MutableByte into a new cohesive class MutableByteArithmetic to reduce the number of public methods and the total methods in MutableByte and concentrate mutation logic into a single class.

expected_impact.rationale: The new class MutableByteArithmetic will encapsulate the mutable byte value and all methods that change or return the value as part of mutation operations (add/subtract/getAnd*/AndGet, increment/decrement, setters/getters related to mutation, and toByte). Moving these public methods and the 'value' field out of MutableByte reduces the target class's public method count and total method count substantially and removes implementation details (LOC) from the target. MutableByte will be simplified to delegate non-mutating responsibilities (Number conversions, compareTo, equals, hashCode) to the arithmetic class, or delegate calls as needed so behavior is preserved within the updated files in this block.
expected_impact.risk_explanation: Behavior is preserved inside the repository by updating MutableByte to use the extracted class. External callers that relied on the moved methods on MutableByte will have to use the new class or updated API; this block performs the internal refactor and keeps the change localized. Risk is medium because a significant portion of the public API is moved.

ops.details: Create new class org.apache.commons.lang3.mutable.MutableByteArithmetic that encapsulates the mutable byte value and provides mutating and arithmetic operations moved from MutableByte. The following members are moved from MutableByte into MutableByteArithmetic (along with the private 'value' field): add(byte), add(Number), addAndGet(byte), addAndGet(Number), getAndAdd(byte), getAndAdd(Number), increment(), incrementAndGet(), getAndIncrement(), decrement(), decrementAndGet(), getAndDecrement(), subtract(byte), subtract(Number), setValue(byte), setValue(Number), getValue() (deprecated), and toByte(). The new class will provide equivalent public methods and a constructor to initialize the internal byte value. The original MutableByte.java is updated to replace the moved field and methods with a single private final MutableByteArithmetic delegate field. Non-mutation methods that remain (Number conversions, compareTo, equals, hashCode, toString if retained) will delegate to the new class for value access where needed. The extraction reduces the number of public methods in MutableByte by removing direct mutating operations and consolidating mutation logic into MutableByteArithmetic. All behavior required by the moved methods is implemented in the new class; MutableByte is updated to preserve behavior for the remaining methods by delegating to the arithmetic instance.
